newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Von Roll says steel pact still valid.
newsitem.headline: Von Roll says steel pact still valid.

text.p: Engineering group Von Roll Holding AG said a contract for the sale of its Swiss steelmaking arm to steel producer Von Moos Holding AG remained valid despite objection from Von Moos.
A Von Roll statement also rejected allegations by Von Moos that it had been misled before signing the contract about the costs and production capacity at Von Roll's domestic steel unit.
Von Moos, which was to become Switzerland's sole remaining steelmaker under the deal, earlier announced it declared the June 28 contract invalid because of costs and conditions at the Von Roll unit.
But Von Roll said the contract remained in force and said it would ask a court to enforce the sale if an agreement could not be reached.
"There is a valid contract of sale between the contractual partner von Moos and Von Roll, by which withdrawal and alteration rights are expressly excluded," Von Roll said.
